name: MiniMax H3 Multi-reference AV Prompting
description: Compile localized storyboard shots and approved asset images into MiniMax H3 native multi-reference synchronized audio-video prompts and reference slots.
when_to_use: MiniMax H3 is the selected video model and CURRENT TARGET_STORYBOARD + TARGET_ASSETS v2 are available
when_not_to_use: A different video model is selected
Required shot assets have no approved reference media

steps.title: 绑定多参考资产
steps.description: Select deterministic Picture slots from approved character/scene/prop reference images used by each shot.

steps.title: 编译 H3 音画提示词
steps.description: Compile model-native execution prompt, target-language speech, camera/action, ambience/SFX, negative constraints, duration and reference conditions.

provider_rules: Use <Picture 1>..<Picture N> exactly in reference connection order
Use at most 9 reference images per segment
Prefer current scene, then speaking/visible characters, then important props
Actors speak only target-language dialogue, verbatim and once
Chinese dialogue translations are review-only and must not be spoken
Request native synchronized picture and audio with natural ambience/SFX
Do not invent assets or references
Runtime executes this contract and must not rewrite it
completion_criteria: Every segment has execution prompt and bounded duration/ratio
Reference slots resolve to real approved media
Skill id/version is persisted in provenance
failure_policy: Missing reference media for a referenced target entity fails closed
More than 9 required image references must be deterministically prioritized; never silently substitute another identity
Prompt compilation never calls video generation
